trap.label: diagnóstico
trap.wrong: The doctor made a diagnostic yesterday.
trap.right: The doctor gave a diagnosis yesterday.
trap.why: Em português “diagnóstico” é o substantivo; o aluno usa diagnostic, que em inglês é adjetivo (diagnostic test). O substantivo é diagnosis.

mcq.q: “In plain terms, it means…” is used to...

opts: Could you tell me what you’ve understood?

fix.wrong: The diagnostic was high blood pressure.
fix.right: The diagnosis was high blood pressure.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com called: “Doctors name this hypertension.”
Reescreva com Think of it as: “It is like a pipe under pressure.”
rewrite.answer: Think of it as a pipe under pressure.
